name: u1-print-studio
description: Set up, prepare, start, and monitor Snapmaker U1 prints with an interactive read-only camera and telemetry dashboard.

interface.longDescription: U1 Print Studio walks a new user through a personal Tailscale and passkey connection, keeps preparation and authorized print start separate, and adds a read-only live camera and telemetry dashboard with adaptive refresh, Picture in Picture, and fullscreen modes.
defaultPrompt: Connect my read-only U1 status card to my phone.
Prepare this model for my Snapmaker U1.
Start this validated U1 print after safety checks.
Monitor my U1 print with adaptive status cards.
